title: test(runtime,client): pay the reader-contexts pin's first loads at module scope and share one auth server across the rotated-token cases
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP5yokEzFQq2X7EXPg3PnHb)_

Part of #23181 (slice 13, `domain:server` seat 1). The card stays open for its other rows and for the refresh that judges these two.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Test-only diff: two test files, nothing published, so `skip-changeset` rides the create.

## The reading this slice used

The newest refresh run, not a landed refresh PR (none has landed since the card's table): `shard-timings-refresh` run `40275747937` (schedule, 2026-10-26T05:43Z, head `2a728ba2a`, 14 hourly full-battery runs `40200279306`..`40272142430`), whose `--diff` step logs every test file over budget. Of this slice's six named files it still lists two:

| file | before (CI, slowest run in window) |
|:--|--:|
| `@objectstack/runtime` `src/stored-metadata-reader-contexts.pin.test.ts` (local) | 16.31 s (`40200279306`) |
| `@objectstack/client` `src/auth-rotated-session-token.test.ts` | 13.62 s (`40200279306`) |

No longer listed (earlier slices closed them): runtime `declared-capability-absence-warn-once.test.ts` and `stored-metadata-body-boundary.pin.test.ts`, rest `import-template-route.test.ts`, client `auth-login-register-envelope.test.ts`. Not touched.

## What changed

**`runtime/src/stored-metadata-reader-contexts.pin.test.ts`.** The file already booted once per file. What its `beforeAll` paid was first use: measured in one process, the first boot took 1962 ms and a second identical boot 673 ms, because the boot `import()`s better-auth and the services' entries lazily and runs every path cold. The boot is now one function (`bootKernel`), and a module-scope `warmUpFirstLoads()` runs it once on a throwaway app (its own manifest, object and database), signs the dev administrator in and runs one sandboxed body, then stops it before `beforeAll`. That is the repo's convention (AGENTS.md: clocked windows measure behaviour, never loading), the same shape as `@objectstack/verify`'s `boot-warm-up.testkit.ts` and rest's `import-template-route.test.ts`. A failed warm-up throws during collection, so it cannot pass silently. `NODE_ENV` is put back as found.

**`client/src/auth-rotated-session-token.test.ts`.** Every case built a fresh engine, schema sync and `AuthManager` (about 150 ms each, measured) before signing a user up. The cases now share one engine and one `AuthManager` (`fileServer()`, built by the first case, destroyed in `afterAll`). Each case still signs up a user of its own through a client of its own, and every assertion is about that user's credential. Because the default audience posture is `invite_only`, each user enters through a pending `sys_invitation` row, the lane `@objectstack/verify`'s signUp and the runtime pin above take. The module-scope warm-up keeps its own server and destroys it before the first case, as before; case ④'s pins (one module-scope `await signedIn();`, one `before*` hook, no widened clock) hold unchanged.

## Measurements (local, 4 vCPU, shared box, through `os-verify-lock`)

Module-line milliseconds (the number the timing table reads), a copy of each file at base `601c77384` interleaved with the file at `453c7e3ae` (this diff before the merge with `origin/main`), three runs each:

| file | before | after | median |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| runtime pin | 5126 / 4957 / 4922 | 3712 / 3750 / 4008 | 4957 → 3750 (−24 %) |
| client rotated-token | 3874 / 4561 / 4161 | 3085 / 3116 / 3371 | 4161 → 3116 (−25 %) |

- **Isolation:** `--sequence.shuffle` with seeds 101, 202 and 303 on both files: 27/27 and 8/8 pass every run, and the verbose order confirms the cases ran shuffled (seed 101 runs client case ③ first).
- **Assertions unchanged:** the `it`/`describe` title lines hash equal at base `601c77384` and head (runtime 28 lines `451ebc4925fbeaaf`, client 12 lines `36683f1bc93a4451`); `expect(` counts 50 = 50 and 43 = 43. No timeout, budget, project or roster entry moved; nothing deleted.
- **What it costs.** The client change removes work (seven fewer engine and auth-manager builds per run). The runtime change moves first-load cost out of the clocked window and adds one warm boot (about 0.7 s of CPU during collection): the whole vitest run's wall is unchanged (33.1 / 33.6 s before, 33.3 / 32.9 s after, two runs on a loaded box).

## Does it close the rows?

Not proven. On the before ratio of each file (CI 16.31 s against 4957 ms local, 13.62 s against 4161 ms), the projections are about 12.3 s for the runtime pin and 10.2 s for the client file. The next landed refresh decides; this PR claims no row as closed.

What is left is behaviour:
- runtime pin: about 40 sandboxed body runs, each of which instantiates a fresh QuickJS WASM module by design (`sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`, ADR-0102 D2), with a major GC roughly every third run (single runs of the same action measured 28 to 142 ms). The `/meta`-authored actions bind on the first poll (measured: 1 poll each), so no wait is left to cut.
- client file: the real scrypt derivations (each case's sign-up plus its password checks) at production parameters.

## Acceptance notes

- Other runtime rows in the same reading, outside this slice's file surface and untouched: `src/domains/mcp-package-object-discovery.test.ts` (local) 14.93 s and `src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` (repo) 13.60 s, both run `40200279306`.
- `packages/runtime` typecheck needs `@objectstack/driver-turso` built (`organization-ownership-boot-guard.turso-remote.kernel.test.ts` imports it) even though it is outside `@objectstack/runtime^...`; a closure-only build reports TS2307 there. Local setup, not a defect.

## Verification

Run at head `df1b49998` (the branch merged with `origin/main`; the two test files are unchanged by the merge), all through `os-verify-lock` except the gates and eslint:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 455 passed (455), Tests 7408 passed | 19 skipped (7427).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client test`: Test Files 52 passed (52), Tests 671 passed (671).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK` for both; each changed file is in its package's `tsconfig.test.json` program (`tsc --listFilesOnly`, 1 hit each).
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/runtime packages/client`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 56 commands; each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe, all 56 exit 0. `--ran`: "Run reconciliation — 56 derived, 56 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0.
- `--sequence.shuffle` (seeds 101, 202, 303) re-run on this head: 27/27 and 8/8 every run.

No ablation: no tested behaviour changed. The diff changes how the two files arrange their servers, not what any case asserts.
